text:
Anika (CEO): Great questions in the AH q&a today  thanks folks. Dropping clarifications and owners for the open items + links to the recording/slides: https://redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23-extended (internal). I'll keep this short. :sparkles:

Priya (VP Product): One ask from the chat: are we shipping a migration CLI or is it just runbook + UI?

Devon (CTO): Short answer: runbook + UI first, CLI is on the backlog for automation-heavy customers. We'll surface a minimal script in the repo for repeatable steps.

Ibrahim (Eng): I'll prototype the script and put it in infra/migration/tools as a beta. It will be opt-in and documented. ETA: PR by 2026-04-06.

Sofia (Data Ops): A few questions around telemetry: will pilot customers' token-level logs be PII-safe? We need clear guidance before enabling detailed retention.

Priya (VP Product): Pilot telemetry will be anonymized by default (hashing + truncation). Customers can opt in to extended telemetry after signing the addendum. Legal to confirm exact terms.

Riley (Sales): Customers also asked whether existing API keys will keep working when routes migrate to Dedicated. Need a simple line in the FAQ.

Devon (CTO): Keys remain compatible; routing is transparent. We'll add a snippet to the FAQ: "No key changes required; route move is server-side."

Anika (CEO): Nice. Below are consolidated action items. Please add JIRA links and ping this thread once created so we can track. If you can't meet dates, flag by 2026-03-29.

Action items:
- Ibrahim (Eng) -> prototype migration CLI script and open PR (infra/migration/tools) due 2026-04-06 (#JIRA-4501)
- Priya (VP Product) -> publish anonymized telemetry policy draft for pilot + FAQ copy about API-key compatibility due 2026-03-31 (#JIRA-4502)
- Sofia (Data Ops) -> vet anonymization approach and provide a short tech note for Legal by 2026-03-30 (#JIRA-4503)
- Devon (CTO) -> confirm CLI roadmap and review Ibrahim's PR by 2026-04-10 (#JIRA-4504)
- Riley (Sales) -> draft a short customer-facing blurb about migration + keys and post here by 2026-03-29 (#JIRA-4505)

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "AH followups: migration script & telemetry sync" 2026-03-31 11:00 PST  https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1952004444

Priya (VP Product): Quick UX ask: can we add a small "preview impact" modal in Console that shows estimated latency/cost delta before migration? That was requested by a large customer in the Q&A.

Devon (CTO): Yes, Product + Infra to spec. It should use recent aggregated stats; default to "no data shown" unless customer opts-in or provides sample. Privacy-first.

Ibrahim (Eng): I'll add a stub API endpoint (/v1/migration/estimate) to the prototype so Console can demo the modal.

Sofia (Data Ops): For the estimator, we'll provide a safe-summary mode that only shares aggregate percent change, never raw tokens. I'll draft the algorithm and post it to #data-ops.

Riley (Sales): I'll collect the customer feedback on the modal wording and share a couple of suggested phrasings for the UI.

Anika (CEO): Thanks everyone  short, concrete asks. Follow-up: I'll check progress in leadership sync next Tuesday. :white_check_mark:
